description: Save a ZIP with the newest proof card of every Instagram post in your campaign plus index.csv (post, link, account, reel, time, views) to a new local .zip file. A proof card is the Instagram reel tile as a VibeVO scan saw it (thumbnail, Instagram view count, handle, UTC time). Requires the read scope.

savePath.description: New local file path ending in .zip; an existing file is never overwritten.

name: vibevo_download_campaign_proofs_zip
title: Download all proof screenshots of a campaign (ZIP)
